svg.title: From evidence to assurance-ready climate reporting — the Sightlines Advisory method
svg.desc: Company information and publicly available information feed a shared AI-assisted, expert-reviewed evidence register, which feeds four compliance steps producing an assurance-ready AASB S2 report, with optional opportunities for strategic uplift branching from each step, repeated each year.

g.text: From evidence to assurance-ready climate reporting
Compliance — AASB S2 requirements applied at every step
Opportunities for strategic uplift — you choose where to go further
Dashed purple lines are decision points — compliance is the floor, not the ceiling
↻ Each year we refresh the baseline rather than rebuild it
